decision.reason: four entry-scoped exact domains remain below gate grade because the owner has 175 unresolved interior-entry sources; the frozen pilot also has no table-backed site and retained evidence cannot supply the mandatory site-time runtime cross-check

gate_grade_entry_scope.definition: accepted proved-or-unknown external-entry gate, extended by the corrected convention-free 179-site work-order universe

no_go_report.item2_bar_facts_no_recommendation: The item-2 bar would have to accept exclusion for all 179 corrected code-only indirect sites that this increment does not prove at gate grade: twelve attempted pilot sites with named walls and 167 sites stopped by the mandatory pilot gate. Four attempted sites have exact domains only from their declared entry; 175 unresolved transfer sites can still enter that owner interior and bypass those definitions. The 179 include all 74 table/cell-backed candidates without a complete whole-table runtime-state invariant and 105 sites in the computed, register, incoming-ra, opaque, or mixed strata. The retained 50 frame-boundary capsules and preserved u3 entry watches contain zero source-site/indirect-target tuples for those sites. The u3 watches record entry hits of 0, 60, 60, and 60 at 0x80018CC4, 0x80018F4C, 0x80019244, and the dead-lexical 0x8001961C value, respectively; those hits do not identify which indirect site supplied the target and therefore do not prove exclusion.
